about: Labelled feedback for evaluating the extraction stage. Icons are paths under runs/heldout-v1 without the .svg suffix. Each expected lesson lists the accepted values per field; optional lessons are neither required nor penalised. Labels by Claude; to be reviewed by the team.

lessons.statement: Generous negative space and low detail.
Exactly one solid accent dot, placed in the gap of the main outline.

items.text: I want them thin and rounded, kind of organic

expected.statement: Prefer organic, softer forms over rigid geometry.

expected.statement: Make icons symmetric and visually balanced.
